messages:
mara: ok confession time 
 I duct-taped a pizza box to my window and angled it like a parabolic dish to stop packet loss during calls. it actually helped. :pizza: :exploding_head:

jonas: pizza box antenna. iconic. did you grease the crust for conductivity? :joy:

ash: pics or it didn't happen. also are you allergic to embarrassment?

mara: posted pics in thread — http://imgur.com/placeholder_mara_box 

kelly: amazing. also slightly terrifying. is that safe for the router's ventilation?

mara: i kept it 6in off the vent and only ran it during meetings. unplugged after. pro tip: sandwich foil inside the box for reflectivity.

oscar: quick technical note: directional reflectors can help if you're in a wooded yard with obstructed LOS. also try shifting Wi-Fi channel before craft projects. `iwlist wlan0 channel` to view.

jonas: `iwlist` saved my life last week when a neighbor's baby monitor stole my 2.4GHz.

ash: ops-bot was our ISP doing maintenance earlier? my lunch meeting had like 3 reconnects.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Residential cluster R7 experienced packet jitter 2026-08-12T12:03:00Z. Window 12:02:5812:05:20 UTC. Intermittent reconnects reported. Ticket INC-2026-632 created.

mara: that explains the timing. glad it wasn't my engineering skills failing. :sweat_smile:

kelly: vote: would you ever try a pizza-box reflector? react with :pizza: for yes, :no_entry: for never.

oscar: :pizza: from me. also reminder: tether as backup if you can, and label your cables if you borrow stuff.

mara: labeling is the responsible adult engineering move. thanks team. will retire the pizza box to the recycling bin now. :recycle:
